name: @jskit-ai/assistant-voice-sherpa
description: Optional native Sherpa speech engine and explicit model preparation for assistant voice.

surfaces.summary: Native Sherpa recognition and synthesis in pools of worker processes, with operator configuration, a host's hotwords and spellings, and a named voice catalogue.
Prepared model integrity manifests, construction and verification.
Portable prepare, verify and serve commands; serve takes a credentials file, hotwords, spellings and worker counts, and a host may supply its own engine.
